label: Good
corporate_parent: Rheem Manufacturing Company — privately held subsidiary of Paloma Industries (Japan). Also operates Ruud brand.

compressor.description: Copeland two-stage scroll compressor. 67%/100% capacity stages. Proven reliable technology.

condenser_coil.description: Traditional construction. No premium coating. Standard durability.

expansion_device.description: Thermostatic expansion valve — standard for two-stage systems.

fan_motor.description: ECM condenser fan motor — 65-75% efficiency, standard premium.

communicating_system.thermostat_requirement: Any thermostat works. No proprietary lock-in.
communicating_system.proprietary_lock_in: None — most open system in the category.

warranty.claim_process: Contractor-friendly — Rheem rated easiest warranty claims among all brands

parts_availability.distribution: Universal — Rheem + independent supply houses. Any contractor can get parts.

service_network.type: National wide independent — any HVAC contractor can service. Zero brand lock-in.

platform_sharing.family: Rheem/Ruud are same unit, different distribution channel. Ruud = wholesale/supply-house distribution. Identical components.
platform_sharing.scoring_rule: Score Rheem. Note Ruud identical in report.

professional_consensus.installer_recommendation: The 'Toyota Camry' of HVAC — reliable, not exciting. Consistently recommended for quality homes on a budget.
professional_consensus.rheem_vs_goodman: Contractors prefer Rheem over Goodman for superior build quality, despite Goodman's better warranty. Rheem = 'boring reliable.'
professional_consensus.prestige_vs_classic: Prestige line meaningfully outperforms Rheem Classic — different components, diagnostics, not just badge engineering.
professional_consensus.floor_for_quality_home: Represents the professional floor for 'acceptable in a quality home' — 16+ SEER2, two-stage minimum.
